summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited financial statements, management's discussion and analysis, earnings press release, dividend press release, and certifications for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic earnings report by a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation filing. No event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change is described. The filing merely reports standard quarterly financial results and dividend declarations.
